audit_metadata.title: Blind-Cohort Continuum Evidence Promotion Safety Remediation Audit Manifest

verdict_justification.summary: The governance defect identified in Task 4.8 has been completely remediated. Blind evaluation cohorts (P0002, P0009, P0010) are now subject to active fail-closed promotion vetoes in EmpiricalContinuumSidecar and ContinuumEvidenceRecord.validate(). When external photometry is present for a blind source, color_excess_detected is forced to False, POSSIBLE_INFRARED_EXCESS and SUPPORTED_PHOTOSPHERIC_CONSISTENCY are mapped to UNVERIFIABLE, BLIND_COHORT_UNVERIFIED_BASELINE is strictly enforced, and candidate-level indications are preserved in metadata without confirmatory claims. Calibration cohort P0008 behavior is 100% preserved, FUSION-X score invariance remains exactly zero, Phase 3 backward compatibility is intact, and all 224 workspace tests pass.
